ja: 彼に拡張機能を入れるよう伝えてもらえる？
en: Could you tell him to install extensions?
alternatives: Can you tell him to install extensions?
Could you ask him to install extensions?
point: tell + 人 + to install の形。that 節にしない

ja: ログが出ない理由がわからないんです。
en: I don't know why logs aren't showing up.
alternatives: I can't figure out why logs aren't appearing.
I don't know why the logs are missing.
point: why の後ろは疑問文の語順にしない

ja: こんな便利な拡張機能、初めて見たよ。
en: I've never seen such a useful extension.
alternatives: I've never seen such a handy extension.
I've never seen an extension this useful.
point: 「初めて見た」は never + 現在完了で言う

ja: コマンドを打つのに慣れてきた。
en: I'm getting used to typing commands.
alternatives: I'm getting comfortable typing commands.
I'm getting the hang of typing commands.
point: get used to の to は前置詞、後ろは typing

ja: ケンが、キャッシュを消せば直るって言ってた。
en: Ken said clearing the cache should fix it.
alternatives: Ken told me clearing the cache would fix it.
Ken said clearing the cache would do the trick.
point: said の後は時制を一つ過去側へ。will でなく should も可

ja: 必要なのは、もっと速いビルド環境です。
en: What I need is a faster build setup.
alternatives: A faster build setup is what I need.
What I need is a quicker build environment.
point: 「必要なのは〜」は What I need is 〜 で言う

ja: 失敗した時、もうキャッシュを消してたよ。
en: I'd already cleared the cache when it failed.
alternatives: When it failed, I'd already cleared the cache.
I'd already deleted the cache when it failed.
point: 失敗より前に消していたので had cleared にする

ja: Docker 入れたらこれ実行して。
en: Run this after you install Docker.
alternatives: Run this once Docker is installed.
After installing Docker, run this.
point: after の後は未来のことでも現在形 install

ja: 先週、全員が同じエディタを入れたよ。
en: Everyone installed the same editor last week.
alternatives: Last week, everyone installed the same editor.
Everybody installed the same editor last week.
point: last week があるので installed と過去形にする

ja: 僕らは設定を見直して、ビルド時間を半分にした。
en: Having reworked the config, we cut build times in half.
alternatives: After reworking the config, we halved our build times.
We reworked the config and cut build times in half.
point: 先に終えた動作は Having＋過去分詞で前置きできる

ja: リンターの設定を順を追って説明してもらえますか？
en: Could you walk me through your linter setup?
alternatives: Could you take me through the linter setup?
Can you go over your linter setup with me?
point: walk me through ＋ 説明してほしい対象を続ける

ja: ターミナルにエラーが出てるよ。
en: There's an error in the terminal.
alternatives: The terminal shows an error.
The terminal is showing an error.
point: 初めて話題に出す名詞は There is + a/an。

ja: ログをひと通り見たけど、手がかりは全然なかったよ。
en: I combed through the logs but found no clues.
alternatives: I went through the logs but found no clues.
I looked through the logs, but found nothing useful.
point: comb through は「くまなく調べる」（look through より徹底的）。

ja: 急ぎでも、本番の設定はいじらないでね。
en: Even if it's urgent, don't edit prod config.
alternatives: Don't edit the prod config, even if it's urgent.
Please don't touch prod config, even if it's urgent.
point: 「たとえ〜でも」は even if、禁止は don't で言える

ja: テーマ設定はどこですか？
en: Where is the theme setting?
alternatives: Where's the theme option?
Where do I change the theme?
Where are the theme settings?
point: Where の後は is + 主語の語順にする

ja: プラグインを更新するまでは、順調に動いてたのに。
en: Everything was humming along until I updated the plugin.
alternatives: It all ran smoothly until I updated the plugin.
Things were fine until I updated the plugin.
point: 更新した時点は過去形、それ以前の状態は過去進行形

ja: リンターは保存時、型チェックはコミット時。
en: Linting runs on save, whereas type checks run on commit.
alternatives: Linting runs on save; type checks run on commit.
The linter runs on save, type checks on commit.
point: 対比は whereas で2つの設定を並べる

ja: この拡張機能、今朝からエディタを固まらせてる。
en: This extension has been freezing my editor since this morning.
alternatives: This extension's been making my editor freeze since this morning.
Since this morning, this extension has kept freezing my editor.
point: 「今朝から」続いているので現在完了進行形にする

ja: 今、拡張機能を入れてるところ。
en: I'm installing an extension now.
alternatives: I'm adding an extension right now.
Right now, I'm installing an extension.
point: 「今〜しているところ」は現在進行形 I'm 〜ing

ja: ビルドの設定を変えてもいいですか？
en: Would you mind if I changed the build settings?
alternatives: Is it okay if I change the build settings?
Could I change the build settings?
point: Would you mind if の後は過去形 changed にする

ja: ステージングのデプロイ、もう一時間も固まってるよ。
en: The staging deploy has been hanging for a good hour.
alternatives: The staging deploy's been stuck for a good hour.
The staging deploy's been hanging for over an hour.
point: 「a good hour」で「たっぷり一時間」の含みが出せる

ja: ターミナルで日本語が打てないんだ。
en: I can't type Japanese in the terminal.
alternatives: I can't type Japanese into the terminal.
The terminal won't let me type Japanese.
I can't enter Japanese in the terminal.
point: 「打てない」は can't type。前置詞は in the terminal

ja: うちは GitHub を毎日使う。
en: We use GitHub every day.
alternatives: Our team uses GitHub daily.
We work with GitHub every day.
point: 毎日は every day と 2 語で書く

ja: 検索の一番速いやり方って何ですか？
en: What's the fastest way to search?
alternatives: What's the quickest way to search?
What's the fastest search method?
point: 最上級には the が必要：the fastest way

ja: 僕は、デフォルト設定をいじることはまずないね。
en: I hardly ever mess with the default settings.
alternatives: I almost never tinker with the default settings.
I rarely touch the default settings.
point: hardly ever は「ほとんど〜ない」。mess with は「いじる」

ja: 最初から依存のバージョンを固定しとけばよかった。
en: I wish I'd pinned the dependency versions from the start.
alternatives: If only I'd locked the dependency versions from day one.
I should have pinned the dependency versions from the beginning.
point: 過去の後悔は wish + 過去完了。pin は「固定する」

ja: 私が入れたプラグイン、もう動いてる？
en: Is the plugin I installed working yet?
alternatives: Is the plugin I added working yet?
Has the plugin I installed started working?
Is the plugin I installed running yet?
point: 入れたプラグイン = the plugin I installed（that は省ける）

ja: ビルド失敗の原因は、設定じゃなく Node だったよ。
en: It was Node, not the config, that broke the build.
alternatives: What broke the build was Node, not the config.
It wasn't the config but Node that broke the build.
point: It was A, not B, that 〜 で原因を強調する
